reflection.theme: The ordinary Tuesday is the whole point
reflection.quote: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
reflection.reading:
Mid-September Tuesday. Nothing on fire, nothing to celebrate, nothing to survive. Just a regular day — the kind that used to feel unbearable because there was nothing to distract from being alive inside my own head. I used to need Tuesdays to become something else. A reason to drink, a story to tell, a way out of the quiet.

What I didn't understand at 22 was that the whole life I actually wanted was hiding inside Tuesdays. Not the mountaintops. The mornings. The drive to work with a coffee that doesn't hurt. The text back to a friend. The workout you almost skipped. The dinner you actually cook instead of ordering because you're too checked out to care. Durant's line about Aristotle gets quoted so much it's almost wallpaper, but sit with it: the person you become is built out of what you do on the days nobody's watching. Including you.

Eleven years in, I can tell you the ski seasons and the trips and the big stuff are real — but they're not what saved me. What saved me was learning to be a person on a Tuesday. To eat a meal, do the dishes, answer the email, go to bed sober. Ordinary is not the consolation prize. Ordinary is where the life gets built.
reflection.meditation: Today, notice one small ordinary moment and let it be enough. That's the reps.

affirmations: I am building a life one ordinary day at a time, and today counts.
Today I have the agency to choose my next action, no matter what came before it.
I am becoming someone I can actually live with, and that work happens in the small stuff.

gratitude.prayer: Grateful for a Tuesday that doesn't need to be rescued. Grateful for a clear head, a body that shows up, and people in my life who know the real version of me. I remember the mornings I couldn't imagine feeling okay in my own skin — and today, mostly, I do. That's not nothing. That's everything.
gratitude.closing: One more day. That's the whole deal.
